artifact:
Feature: Doorstop functionality

  As a user of Doorstop, I want to ensure that the tool provides unique and permanent identifiers, supports formatting, storage, import, export, viewing, and baselining of requirements.

Scenario Outline: Unique and permanent identifiers
  Given I have a linkable section of text
  When I apply Doorstop to the text
  Then I should receive a unique and permanent identifier

  Examples:
    | Text                                                   | Identifier                                                  |
    | "Requirement for user login"                            | "DST-UID-001"                                             |
    | "Security protocol for data encryption"                   | "DST-UID-002"                                             |
    | "Empty section"                                        | "DST-UID-003"                                             |
    | "Section with special characters: #$%&*"             | "DST-UID-004"                                             |

Scenario Outline: Formatting support
  Given I have a linkable section of text with formatting
  When I apply Doorstop to the text
  Then I should support formatting within the linkable text

  Examples:
    | Text with bold                                          | "DST-FT-001"                                             |
    | Text with italic                                        | "DST-IT-001"                                             |
    | Text with underline                                     | "DST-UL-001"                                             |
    | Text with hyperlink                                     | "DST-HL-001"                                             |

Scenario Outline: Storage of external requirements assets
  Given I have an external requirement asset
  When I store it in Doorstop
  Then I should be able to retrieve it later

  Examples:
    | External requirement asset file                          | "DST-SA-001"                                             |
    | External requirement asset image                         | "DST-SA-002"                                             |
    | External requirement asset document                       | "DST-SA-003"                                             |

Scenario Outline: Import content from other tools
  Given I have content from another requirements management tool
  When I import it into Doorstop
  Then I should be able to interact with it

  Examples:
    | Content from JIRA                                       | "DST-IC-001"                                             |
    | Content from Confluence                                  | "DST-IC-002"                                             |
    | Content from Trello                                      | "DST-IC-003"                                             |

Scenario Outline: Export to common text/document tools
  Given I have content in Doorstop
  When I export it to a common text/document tool
  Then I should be able to interact with the exported content

  Examples:
    | Exported content to Microsoft Word                        | "DST-ET-001"                                             |
    | Exported content to Google Docs                           | "DST-ET-002"                                             |
    | Exported content to PDF                                  | "DST-ET-003"                                             |

Scenario Outline: Viewing requirements as a document
  Given I have a set of requirements
  When I view them as a document in Doorstop
  Then I should be able to see them in a structured format

  Examples:
    | Requirements for user login                             | "DST-VD-001"                                             |
    | Requirements for data encryption                          | "DST-VD-002"                                             |
    | Requirements for Trello integration                       | "DST-VD-003"                                             |

Scenario Outline: Interactive view of document items
  Given I have a document item in Doorstop
  When I interact with it
  Then I should be able to view it in an interactive manner

  Examples:
    | User login requirement                                    | "DST-IV-001"                                             |
    | Data encryption requirement                               | "DST-IV-002"                                             |
    | Trello integration requirement                            | "DST-IV-003"                                             |

Scenario Outline: Baselining of requirements
  Given I have a set of requirements
  When I baseline them in Doorstop
  Then I should be able to create a baseline version

  Examples:
    | Requirements for user login                             | "DST-BV-001"                                             |
    | Requirements for data encryption                          | "DST-BV-002"                                             |
    | Requirements for Trello integration                       | "DST-BV-003"                                             |
